The context data is structured as follows:
Context Data (2 Byte)

ControllerID (1 Byte)
•
ErrorCounterThreshold (1 Byte)

TxErrorCounter > 127 AND RxErrorCounter > 127(0x0)

TxErrorCounter > 127 AND RxErrorCounter < 127 (0x1)

RxErrorCounter > 127 AND TxErrorCounter < 127 (0x2)

7.28 Error classification
[SWS_CANIF_00223]
⌈
For all defined production errors it is only required to report
the event, when an error or diagnostic relevant event (e.g. state changes, no L-PDU
events) occurs. Any status has not to be reported.
